newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Artu shares continue unexplained ascent.
newsitem.headline: Artu shares continue unexplained ascent.

text.p: Shares in small Dutch biotechnology firm Artu Biologicals continued to gain on Thursday in heavier than usual trading.
But dealers said they had heard nothing unusual in the market or from the company itself to explain the rise.
The shares were up 1.20 guilders at 10.20 this morning with bourse statistics showing over 400,000 shares changing hands.
Since October 4 trading volumes have been well in excess of average daily volume of around 20,000 shares and the price has almost doubled from levels of just over five guilders.
